join.q: How do I join the server?
join.a: Press "Join the server" or open the CS2 console (the ~ key) and type connect {address}. If the console does not open, enable it in the game settings (Game → Enable Developer Console).

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No — all you need is Counter-Strike 2 on Steam. The de_dust2 map ships with the game and the server needs no mods on your side.

mode.a: Free-for-all Deathmatch on de_dust2 only: you respawn instantly, with no teams and no rounds. The weapon modes rotate from time to time — the current one is shown in the status above.

xp.q: How do I earn XP and levels?
xp.a: By getting kills: 10 XP each plus bonuses for headshots, knife kills, noscopes, wallbangs, kills through smoke, revenge and claimed bounties. Level n needs 100 · n · (n − 1) / 2 XP in total.

vip.q: Does VIP give an in-game advantage?
vip.a: No — VIP is cosmetic only: a tag, a name colour and a reserved slot. Nothing that affects the game itself.

stats.q: Where can I see my stats?
stats.a: On the leaderboard — find your name and open your profile. It shows K/D, accuracy, weapon mastery and a map of your kills for the last 30 days.

skins.q: Are there skins, knives or ranks?
skins.a: No — the server follows Valve's community server guidelines, which forbid plugins for skins, knives, gloves, agents and fake ranks.

banned.q: I was banned unfairly — what can I do?
banned.a: Write to us through the contact page with your SteamID64 and the date of the ban. Appeals with Steam sign-in are coming soon.

fair.title: No in-game advantage
fair.text: VIP has no extra health, no faster respawn, no better weapons and no lighter restrictions — the rules are the same as for everyone. Nobody gets skins, knives or ranks: Valve's community server guidelines forbid them.

rules.lead: The server is about fair play and a good mood. The rules apply to everyone — VIPs and admins included.

cheats.title: No cheats
cheats.text: Programs and scripts that give an advantage are forbidden: aimbots, wallhacks, triggerbots, macros and the like. The penalty is a permanent ban.

toxicity.title: No insults
toxicity.text: No insults, threats, racism or harassment — in chat, in voice or in your name.

ads.title: No advertising
ads.text: No advertising of other servers, websites, services or sales — in chat, in voice or in your name.

exploits.title: No bug abuse
exploits.text: If you find a bug on the map or in the game that gives an advantage (for example a spot where you cannot be hit), tell us and do not use it.

impersonation.title: No impersonation
impersonation.text: Do not pretend to be an admin, another player or the server team.

spam.title: No spam
spam.text: No flooding of chat or voice and no abuse of commands.

penalties.title: Penalties
penalties.lead: The penalty depends on the violation and on whether it is repeated:
items: A warning.
Muting voice (mute), chat (gag) or both.
A kick from the server.
A temporary ban — moderators can ban for up to 7 days, administrators for longer.
A permanent ban — for cheating and for serious or repeated violations.
penalties.public: Active bans are visible on the ban list: only the name, SteamID64, category, date and expiry. The reason is not public.

appeal.title: Appeals
items: Appeals will work with Steam sign-in on this website.
Until then, write to us through the contact page with your SteamID64, the date and why you think the penalty is a mistake.
Every appeal is reviewed by a person on the team and you get a reasoned answer.

privacy.lead: How the CarbonStealth.eu | Dust2 DM server and this website process personal data — briefly and without small print.

controller.title: Who is responsible for the data
body: The controller of personal data is {company} — the publisher of the server and of the website. The company details are in the imprint; for any question about your data, write to us through the contact page.

game.title: What we record when you play
items: SteamID64 — your Steam account number; stats and penalties are kept against it.
Your in-game name (Steam nickname) at the time you play.
Your IP address when you join the server — to protect against abuse and to enforce bans; we keep it for {sessionsDays} days.
Stats: kills, deaths, assists, shots fired and hits, streaks, XP, time played and kills per weapon.
Every kill with the weapon, the time and the map coordinates — for the kill maps; we keep them for {killsDays} days.

SourceTV recordings (demos) of matches while people are on the server: nickname, SteamID64, movement, shots and chat messages — to review reports of cheating and rule breaking; voice chat is not recorded. We keep them for up to {demosDays} days.
If you mute the kill-streak sounds (!qs) or change the language (!lang), the server remembers your SteamID64 with that choice until the next update of the server mods.
Penalties: type, category, expiry and an internal reason that only admins can see.
Roughly the last 2000 server events (joins, kills, chat) are held briefly in working memory for moderation and are overwritten continuously; chat is not stored in the database.

website.title: What we record when you browse the website
items: The website uses no cookies, analytics, ads or trackers — which is why there is no consent banner either.
Your IP address is only used to limit the number of requests (overload protection); it is held in memory for up to 1 minute and is not written to any log.
If a player has signed in to the website with Steam, their avatar is loaded from Steam's servers (Valve) — your browser then connects to them.

purposes.title: Why, and on what legal basis
items: Running the game, stats and the public leaderboard — legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): players want to see their results. You can object — we then hide you from the leaderboards and your profile.
Security, protection against cheaters (including the demo recordings) and enforcing bans (including the IP address) — legitimate interest.
A public ban list with minimal data (name, SteamID64, category, date and expiry) — legitimate interest: transparency and protecting the community. The reason is not public.
VIP — performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) and the legal obligation to keep accounting records (Art. 6(1)(c)).
Appeals and notices — legitimate interest: a decision on every case.

retention.title: How long we keep the data
items: IP addresses when joining (sessions) — {sessionsDays} days, then they are deleted automatically.
Kills with coordinates — {killsDays} days, then they are deleted automatically.
Demos (SourceTV recordings) — up to {demosDays} days, then they are deleted automatically (sooner if they take up too much space).
Appeals and notices — 1 year after the decision, then they are deleted automatically.
Stats — for as long as the server runs or until you ask for them to be deleted.
Penalties — for as long as they are needed for the security of the server.
Invoice details for VIP — as long as the Bulgarian Accountancy Act requires.
Match cards (nickname and result in each match) — {matchesDays} days, then deleted automatically.

recipients.title: Who else sees the data
items: Every visitor sees the leaderboard, player profiles (except hidden ones) and the ban list — with the data described above.
The provider of the server that runs the game and the database processes the data on our behalf. The server is located in the EU.
Valve (Steam) processes your account data under its own policy — we do not pass anything to them.
We do not sell data, do not use it for advertising and do not transfer it outside the EU.

steam.title: Data from Steam
items: Right now the website reads nothing from the Steam Web API — it only uses the SteamID64 and nickname the game server sees when you join.
When we introduce Steam sign-in (for appeals and VIP), we will read only your public name and avatar from the Steam Web API — and only after you sign in yourself.
This data is stored on our server in the EU, is not passed to third parties and is used under the Steam Web API Terms of Use.

rights.title: Your rights
items: Access — to find out what data we hold about you and to get a copy.
Rectification and erasure, when the data is inaccurate or no longer needed.
Restriction of processing.
Portability — your stats in a machine-readable format.
Objection — including being hidden from the leaderboards and your profile.
A complaint to the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (www.cpdp.bg) or to the supervisory authority of the country where you live.
body: For any request, write to us through the contact page with your SteamID64. We may ask you to confirm that the account is yours. We reply within one month.

changes.title: Changes
body: If we change this text, the date at the top changes, and we will announce significant changes on the website.

vipTerms.lead: Short and clear: what you buy, how you pay and how you can withdraw.

provider.title: Provider
body: The VIP service is provided by {company}. The company details are in the imprint; to reach us, use the contact page.

subject.title: What you buy
body: VIP is a digital service: cosmetic features on the CarbonStealth.eu | Dust2 DM server for a set period, tied to your SteamID64. VIP gives no in-game advantage and cannot be transferred or sold.

prices.title: Prices
body: Prices are in euro including VAT and are those published on the VIP page at the time of the request. There are no hidden fees.

order.title: Request, payment and start
items: Requests will be made through the website (coming soon) with your SteamID64, invoice details and email.
You receive a confirmation and the details for a bank transfer. The invoice is issued by {company}.
VIP is activated by hand once the payment arrives. If you expressly ask for VIP to start before the 14-day withdrawal period ends, it starts right after activation.

period.title: Term and renewal
body: VIP is valid for the period of the chosen tier from activation. There is no automatic renewal and there are no automatic payments — a new period only comes with a new request.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal (14 days)
items: As a consumer, you can withdraw from the contract within 14 days of its conclusion without giving any reason.
If you expressly asked for VIP to start before the period ends, on withdrawal you pay the part proportionate to the period used until the withdrawal, and we refund the rest.
To withdraw, send us a clear statement through the contact page with your SteamID64 and the invoice number. We refund the amount within 14 days to the account it was paid from.

rules.title: Rules and penalties
body: VIP gives no immunity: the server rules and the same penalties apply as for every player.

availability.title: Server availability
body: We aim to keep the server running continuously, but Counter-Strike 2 updates from Valve and maintenance can stop it temporarily.

complaints.title: Questions and disputes
items: For questions and complaints, write to us through the contact page.
If we cannot agree, you can turn to the Bulgarian Commission for Consumer Protection (www.kzp.bg) and its conciliation committees for out-of-court dispute resolution.
Bulgarian law applies, without depriving you of the protection given to you by the law of the country where you live.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.sayLabel: Message to everyone on the server
dashboard.modeConfirm: Change the mode for all players?
dashboard.noLive: No fresh data from the plugin — the player list is not available.

punish.hint: Empty duration = permanent. Moderators ban for up to 7 days; longer and permanent bans need an admin. The reason is visible only in the panel, never on the public ban list.

punishments.title: Punishments
punishments.lead: The internal list — with the reason and the admin. The public ban list shows only the player, the category and the dates.
punishments.newLead: Works for a player who is not on the server too. If they are online, the server applies it at once.

player.immune: This player's role is equal to or higher than yours — actions on them are locked.
player.roleConfirm: Change the role? All of the player's panel sessions will be ended.
player.hideLabel: Hide from leaderboards and the public profile (GDPR Art. 21)
player.totpResetConfirm: Reset TOTP? The player will have to enrol again on the next sign-in.
player.vipHint: Manual grant, no payment. If the player already has active VIP, the new period starts when it ends.
player.vipNoTiers: To grant VIP, first create at least one tier (e.g. “VIP”, 30 days) in
player.sessionsNote: Joins are kept for 30 days. Only admins see IP addresses.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Reports from the game (!report). The decision is final; a punishment is issued separately.

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.lead: Appeals against punishments. The decision comes with a reason and is final.
appeals.acceptRevokes: An accepted appeal revokes the punishment — you need the rights to revoke it.
appeals.acceptConfirm: Accept the appeal and revoke the punishment?

vip.title: VIP tiers
vip.lead: The tiers and prices the website shows. VIP is cosmetic only — no in-game advantage.
vip.name: Name
vip.priceHint: For example 4.99 — stored in whole euro cents.
vip.inUse: The tier is in use — it can only be deactivated.

banners.title: Map banners
banners.lead: Placed in the game with !banner add. A deleted banner disappears on the next map change.
banners.note: Deleting is written to the audit as banner.remove.

audit.title: Audit
audit.lead: Every admin action from the game, the panel and the bot. The hash chain shows whether a row was tampered with or deleted.
audit.brokenAt: The first mismatch is at row #{id}.

server.title: Server
server.restartConfirm: Restart the server? All players will be kicked.
server.stopConfirm: Stop the server? All players will be kicked and the server stays down until you start it again — updates do not start it.
server.updateConfirm: Run an update check? On a new version the server restarts.
server.controlNote: Start, stop, restart and update cannot run at the same time.
server.logsNote: IP addresses and keys are redacted before display.

settings.title: Server settings
settings.lead: They apply in game right away: after saving, the panel sends a command to the plugin, and the plugin also checks them every 60 seconds. A group that is not set follows the plugin config.
settings.pluginLive: The plugin is online — after saving you will see whether it confirmed.
settings.pluginOffline: No fresh data from the plugin. The value stays in the database and applies when the plugin starts.
settings.default: Not set — the plugin config applies. The fields show the default values.
settings.invalid: The stored value is corrupted — the plugin ignores it and uses its config. Save it again.
settings.resetConfirm: Delete this value? The plugin config will apply.

adverts.title: Chat adverts
adverts.intervalHint: 0 = off; otherwise {min} to {max} seconds. Every advert is shown in the player's language.

builtinItems.site: The server website — leaderboard, stats, VIP

adverts.customHint: Up to {count} texts per language, up to {max} characters. Colour codes and curly braces are removed, as in chat. Players with another language see the English ones.

ammo.title: Ammo
ammo.label: Infinite reserve (topped up on every reload)
ammo.hint: The same as “Infinite ammo” in the !admin menu — a change in one place shows in the other.

bots.title: Bots
bots.label: Number of bots (bot_quota)
bots.hint: 0 to {max}. Bots fill the server and leave as people join. The same as “Bots” in the !admin menu.

xp.title: XP multiplier
xp.label: Multiplier
xp.hint: {min} to {max} in steps of 0.1. It applies equally to everyone. During an active event the higher of the two applies.

join.title: Welcome on join
join.label: Show the welcome message in chat when someone joins
join.hint: With the welcome off, the message about the current event on join is off as well.

stats.title: Statistics — edit
stats.lead: Every change goes into the audit with “before → after” and raises the stats epoch (now {epoch}): the plugin takes the values from the database and drops what it has not saved for the player yet — up to 10 seconds of their latest play are lost.
stats.dataLink: Everything we store about the player
stats.none: The player has no statistics yet.
stats.rules: Whole numbers ≥ 0 only. Headshots, bounties and revenges cannot exceed kills.
stats.weaponsNone: No weapon kills in this season.
stats.playtimeHint: Now: about {h} h. Season playtime is the field of each season.

reset.title: Reset
reset.note: Sets the numbers to zero (the rows stay to keep the epoch). The audit keeps the old values.
reset.seasonConfirm: Reset the player's statistics for the current season?
reset.allConfirm: Reset ALL of the player's statistics (every season, weapons and playtime)?

data.title: Data of {name}
data.lead: Everything the database stores about this player — the raw rows, column names as in the database. Secrets are never shown: for the second factor only whether it is set; session tokens and code hashes are not read.
data.note: At most {limit} rows per section are shown (the latest). Kills are kept for 90 days, sessions for 30.

counts.auditBy: Audit entries with them as admin

events.title: Scheduled events
events.lead: The plugin checks the schedule every 30 seconds: on start it announces the event in each player's language, starts the mode (if any) and raises the XP multiplier; on end it announces and restores. Times are in the {tz} zone.
events.rules: No overlaps; up to 14 days; the end must be in the future. “Mode” needs a DM mode, “XP weekend” a multiplier above 1. Titles go to the game chat — colour codes are removed.
events.empty: No events in the last 30 days.
events.cancelConfirm: Cancel the event? If it is running, the plugin stops it within 30 seconds.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.lead: The server mods from the verified catalogue: start and stop live, install and remove (with a restart), and each one’s config. The site never uploads code — every plugin is pinned by sha256 in the catalogue.
plugins.addNote: A new plugin? Ask the developer: they read its code, verify it and add it to the catalogue. Then it shows up here.
plugins.busy: The server is installing a plugin or updating right now — the buttons come back when it finishes.
plugins.metamodNote: Metamod plugin: starting and stopping take effect after a server restart.
plugins.coreNote: Core — not managed from the panel.

confirm.install: Installing downloads the plugin, verifies it and restarts the server (1–3 minutes) — players will be disconnected. Continue?
confirm.remove: Removing deletes the plugin’s files and restarts the server — players will be disconnected. The config stays. Continue?
confirm.disable: The plugin stops right away and stays stopped after a restart. Continue?

serverlistplayersfix.name: ServerListPlayersFix
serverlistplayersfix.desc: Shows the real player list in the server browser.

quakesounds.name: Quake Sounds
quakesounds.desc: Announcer sounds for kill streaks (Double Kill, Rampage…).

cosmetics.name: Cosmetics
cosmetics.desc: Death beam — an effect where a player went down.

demorecorder.name: Demo Recorder
demorecorder.desc: Records SourceTV demos of the matches; kept for 14 days.

cheatertroll.name: Cheater Troll
cheatertroll.desc: Trolls confirmed cheaters instead of only banning them; the list is in its config.

metablock.name: MetaBlock
metablock.desc: Blocks the meta, css_plugins and css console commands for players.

counterstrikesharp.name: CounterStrikeSharp
counterstrikesharp.desc: The platform for the C# plugins.

deathmatch.name: Deathmatch
deathmatch.desc: The Deathmatch mode — configured in “Settings” and the modes.

carbonstealth.name: CarbonStealth
carbonstealth.desc: Our plugin: bans, XP, menu and the link to this panel.

multiaddonmanager.name: MultiAddonManager
multiaddonmanager.desc: The Workshop addons (banners, sounds) — switches on by itself when there are any.

config.title: Config: {name}
config.lead: The file {file} on the server. Saving checks the JSON, stores it and reloads the plugin live if it is running.
config.label: JSON
config.hint: A valid JSON object only, up to {max} characters. It survives deploys.
config.resetConfirm: The config will be replaced with our default and the plugin will reload. Continue?
config.edited: Edited from the panel — deploys do not overwrite it.
config.offline: The server is not running — the config can only be read and written while the server is up.

matches.lead: Every match is one map until it changes (30 minutes). Only kills between people count. Cards are kept for 90 days.
matches.empty: No finished matches yet. Join and play the first one.

match.caption: Results of match #{id}, by place
match.note: Place is by kills, then fewer deaths and more headshots.

report.aside: This report comes from the match record. We keep matches and kill details for {days} days.
report.notRecorded: No kill details were recorded for this match.
report.multiEmpty: No streak of 3 or more kills in this match.
report.note: The comparison is with the average per match in the days before this one, not with the best day.

compare.title: Compared with usual

lead.one: The average is from {count} match in the {days} days before this one.
lead.other: The average is from {count} matches in the {days} days before this one.

compare.none: No matches in the {days} days before this one — nothing to compare with.

heat.title: Deaths in this match
heat.lead: Aggregated cells on our A–H × 1–8 grid only, never live positions.
heat.pending: The map appears {hours} h after the match ends.

desc.one: {count} death in the match; most in sector {sector}.
desc.other: {count} deaths in the match; most in sector {sector}.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.notRecorded: No kill details were recorded for this match.

multi.title: Streaks
multi.lead: At least 3 kills in a row, at most {seconds} s apart and without dying in between.
multi.empty: No streak of 3 or more kills.

collection.title: Collector
collection.empty: No no-scope, wallbang, through-smoke or blind kills.
